company.name: Tpaga
company.shortDescription: Tpaga is a fintech company that develops and operates a transactional app for financial services.
company.description: TPaga is incorporating agentic AI into its financial services, positioning itself as a next-generation fintech in Latin America. It acts as a one-stop shop for banks, retailers, and telcos who want to launch financial services. TPaga was the first fintech to launch a neobank, white-label mobile wallet, WhatsApp banking, soft pos, and now AGENTIC AI for financial services.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,361,001 to $24,700,000, a 4.61x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 87 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
